items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I used to box on Wednesday night for Tommy Ryan who had the Des Moines ATHLETIC Club there

ctx.x: So you were there by yourself?

I'm there by myself. So I finally run into, after sleeping in the post office here and slept in LaSalle Park (PHONETIC) a couple nights and it was getting kind of cool. I ran into a fellow that I used to box with when I was selling newspapers in Des Moines. All this time I belonged to the newsboys and the Y and I used to box on Wednesday night for Tommy Ryan who had the Des Moines ATHLETIC Club there, we'd fight preliminaries. And I run into this guy, his name was Eddie Hilliard, he was washing dishes down by the…

So one day I was walking up by Lincoln Hall on 18th and Vine and I heard music. So I go upstairs and there was a bunch of kids up there playing. And there was a bunch of fellows from Pittsburgh, they were on their way to California, Raymond --
